messages:
sara.b: Drafting a short playbook for service-surface curations and long-term paydown. Posting checklist + timeline for feedback.
leo.k: drop it here when you have it.
sara.b: ```Playbook checklist:
- Map every public route to a single owning team + fallback owner
- Measure contract churn via diffs on published OpenAPI/proto artifacts
- Limit extraction PRs to ~400 LOC or split into follow-ups
- Migration safety: twilight reads + dual-write adapters behind feature flags
- Observability: ensure spans cover entry->exit and token latency histograms
- Canary rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100%, abort thresholds on error/latency delta
- Debt goal: reduce sync cross-service calls by 30% in Q2 by dedup/sagas
- PR flow KPI: avg days to merge < 3; blocked PRs < 5/wk
- Test parity: adapter integration tests >= 95% pass rate
- Rollback: automated route switch to legacy on breach
```
ajay.eng: thumbs up. small nuance: data migrations that remove fields need migration adapters that tolerate partial reads for 2-3 deploy cycles. prefer incremental adapters vs waveform cutovers.
maria.pm: timeline and ownership ask?
sara.b: plan = 2w design spikes + 6w extraction sprints (3x2w) + 1w cutover window. Product to own acceptance tests and dashboards; infra to provide canary plumbing and route flip runbook.
leo.k: how do we compute "contract churn" across all teams? sounds noisy.
sara.b: approach = automated diffs of deployed artifacts; proxy emits metric when schema changes observed + weekly report. keep it conservative (only public stable endpoints count).
ajay.eng: add runbooks for adapter-toggle matrix and a safety net: if canary error delta > 0.5% or p99 latency +20% -> auto-fallback.
maria.pm: i'll own the KPI dashboard tiles (canary metrics, contract churn, PR throughput). scheduling sync with eng leads for Tue arch meeting.
sara.b: added PR throughput KPI per leo. also adding a short section on measuring "blocked work" tied to refactor tickets.
infra-bot: New RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/refactor-playbook (id: RFC-4333)
leo.k: :thumbsup: please link the twilight read runbook when Ajay has it.
ajay.eng: i'll post the runbook + adapter toggle matrix by COB today.
sara.b: thanks all. i'll update the doc and tag reviewers.
